blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Antonia Ruzic – Hong Kong Open quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala survived another grueling battle in the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open, beating Antonia Ruzic of Croatia, 7-6 (7), 7-5, on Friday to advance to the semifinals. Eala battled through another lengthy tiebreak for the second night in a row, then rallied in the second set after losing a 4-2 lead to wrap up the match in two hours, 30 minutes.
